title: How a reconnecting stream replays events

scope.summary: The event log and read() in src/stream.py, and the producer in src/producer.py.

plan.subject: area
rationale: Recorded runs of the reconnect driver show what the browser receives for each drop.
The producer recording adds a second dataset because it shows task switching that the stream runs cannot show.
The terms dataset is authored because names are read from the code and no run shows them.

sections.title: The names in the stream
sections.body: Four names carry this lesson. Two belong to reading and two to the paths a read takes.

items.meaning: The id of the last event the reader saw.
Raised when the cursor is past the last event.
Yields the stored events after the cursor.
Replays, then yields events as the running turn appends them.
